title: THE BOSS sector, a first version (owner, 2026-10-15): the Cutis-Maku fight from the boss lab as the sector after the back door; Isao drives the tank as the lure on the hull's own avoid autopilot, the player takes the gunship by manual override after a two-button choice, a wave of twenty small Cutis then the boss hunt the tank, every hit on a Cutis body scaled by its phase (the reach is the weak spot), SECURE on the boss's death; BOTH WALLS moves to the sector after
context: Owner, 2026-10-15: 'next we will investigate how to bring in this boss fight; /Users/minikai/Dev/stalheart-cutis-boss, replacing ISAO as a lure, with ISAO-Controlling the Tank as lure, while we control the Gunship. (Actually we could make it a funny choice; ISAO offering to either drive the tank, or let the gunship on autopilot. they land on the idea that since it's a new target, a round of manual-override of the gunship is needed. This Boss fight will be somewhere around round 8.' Spec docs/superpowers/specs/2026-10-15-boss-sector-design.md, plan docs/superpowers/plans/2026-10-15-boss-sector.md. What existed: the Cutis-Maku scenario in the boss lab (branch cutis-boss, merged; src/labs/boss/cutis-scenario.js: Isao the drone as the bait, the player in the game's gunship seat hosted by the lab, CUTIS_BOSS health 180, CUTIS_WAVE 20 at 20 hp, CUTIS_HITS by phase), the Cutis family running in the story through the creature seam with a huge tier, the hunters (2026-10-15-hunters-first-version: a record walks the exits nearer the tank), the hull's avoid directive (src/fx/hull-drive.js chooseNext flees the nearest live enemy), the gunship seat through the strip's GUNSHIP button (the station call, the briefing rule) and its autopilot switch (story.gsAuto), the special-sector pattern (src/domain/sectors.js sectorDef slots the door at doorAt and both at doorAt + 1; src/fx/canyon-run.js).

src/fx/sector-run.js finalSector = doorAt + 2, the brief sector_boss, api.bossBegin(def) as the sector begins (after the card and the breach), bossQueueOf for the row's waves (src/domain/boss-sector.js bossWaves: the family's tier at the row's hit points, every entry a hunter, 0.6 s apart) and api.bossEnd(outcome) at the finish; the wave hook tells the creature module a boss row sends its own hunters. src/domain/boss-sector.js (pure): bossWaves, phaseScale (COIL/EXTEND/ANCHOR full, REST/SETTLE half, TRANSFER none, no phase 1), bossAlive. src/fx/creature-cutis.js phase(handle) (the kit's stage), src/fx/creature-bodies.js phaseOf(record), src/fx/creature-enemies.js damageScale(record) and damageEnemy multiplies by it. src/fx/choice-card.js (Isao's line and two buttons over the paused game, keys 1/2, the debrief's button look; styles.css .choice-card). src/fx/boss-run.js: begin pauses under the choice, either pick brings Isao's reply (a brief), the hull on avoid with autoMode on, Isao's drone docked over the hull (its position each frame, the worker's altitude), the gunship's autopilot off, the call meter filled and the strip's GUNSHIP button clicked once a second until the seat is taken; tick keeps Isao docked and says the lines (boss_rises with a CUTIS-MAKU callout, boss_hit_me on the hull's first loss); rows() the integrity strip's row (WAVE · CUTIS n/20, then CUTIS-MAKU hp/180); end restores the directive, the auto mode and the autopilot, leaves the gunship seat, says boss_dead on a secure. src/td-tab.js: the run's literal (host-contracts hold), storyApi.bossBegin/bossEnd, the per-frame tick, the row merged into the integrity tick, state().boss for the harness. src/isaobriefs.js: sector_boss and the five lines as captions; ~/Dev/seiyu_voice/ISAO-VOICE-LINES.md section 16 (the six triggers, for the owner to record; commit 6951349 there). Not in this version: fear and stun from the player's guns on the boss, the lab's arena, the tank's cannon by Isao, the 'absorbed' flash on a transfer hit, difficulty.
alternatives: THE BOSS before the door (doorAt - 1, the canyon again moved earlier): one line in sectorDef; the owner said around round 8, and after the door the base is whole for the fight.
Isao's drone as the bait as in the lab: rejected by the owner (the tank is the lure); the hull's avoid autopilot is the bait's rules already.
Reuse the lab's scenario module on the planet: rejected; the game's creature seam already draws the Cutis tiers in the story, with the game's damage, kill and books.
Force the gunship seat directly (mountGunship): rejected; the strip's button carries the station call and the briefing rule, and the player sees the handover as any seat.

browser, 2026-10-16: --boss-sector green (the door played through with the probe's culls; THE BOSS as the sector after; the choice card up with the game paused, picked; the hull on its avoid autopilot; the gunship seat taken through the strip's button; the wave of small Cutis hunters up, 8 at 12 s, 20; the bar row; the Cutis-Maku up at 180 after the wave was culled; SECURE on its death and the run restored: the hull manual, the seat left). Found on the way: the controller lacked the isaoSpeak import (Isao's reply threw and the run stopped short of the autopilot); nextWaveIndex returns the ladder's wave index, not the breach's count, so the row's queue is built on wavesReleased; a seat's entry and any drive input flip the hull back to manual, so the run re-asserts the autopilot every frame. Regressions green after: --descent, --sectors, --finale, --canyon-again, --backdoor, --skip-tutorial, --seats, --gunship-auto, --colony, --chapters; --pearl-story's hull probe red once on the drifter lane (a cored body stops the hull, 25.2 -> 23.8) and rerun
